Docs.summary: Provides services, sessions, requests, and hotword detectors for a voice interaction assistant.

remarks.para: A voice interaction service starts sessions that interact with the user and handle requests from applications. Sessions can display a user interface, receive assist data, and track visible activities. Hotword detectors report keyphrase availability and recognition events.
These APIs are implemented in the Android voice interaction sources. The .NET binding also provides enum values, string projections of Java character sequences, and nested interface-constant classes.
